transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.intro: Transfers of this entity, most recent first. Open a transfer to see its files, resend its notification or delete it before it expires.
transfers.introReadOnly: Transfers of this entity, most recent first. Open a transfer to see its files and recipients.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: Invitations sent by internal users to external people so they can deposit files. You can revoke an invitation at any time.

blocklist.title: Blocklist
blocklist.intro: Email addresses, domains and SHA-256 file digests that can no longer deposit or be deposited on this entity.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens let scripts and third-party software deposit files through the API. A token is shown only once, when it is created.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Alerts of this entity (virus detected, abuse, quotas) sent to a Microsoft Teams or Slack channel, or to any JSON receiver such as a SIEM, in addition to the emails.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Actions recorded for this entity over the last 12 months: deposits, downloads, invitations, administrator actions and more.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Activity of this entity over a period: transfers, volumes sent and downloaded, downloads, virus detections and storage used.

privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.intro: Search for an email address to see the data linked to it in this entity, then erase it if needed (data subject rights, GDPR).

abuseReports.title: Abuse reports
abuseReports.intro: Reports made by recipients from the download page. The message is plain text, to be read with caution.

security.title: Security log
security.intro: Security events of this entity over the last 12 months: wrong verification codes or transfer passwords, refused deposits, rate limits, invalid tokens. Identical events seen within a short time are grouped. The log never contains an email address.

dropLinks.title: Drop links
dropLinks.intro: A drop link is a permanent address you give to third parties (customers, suppliers...) so that they can send files to a service, without an invitation. Every deposit requires the depositor to confirm their address with a code. The files are addressed to the recipients of the link.
dropLinks.introReadOnly: Permanent drop links of this entity, read-only.

secrets.title: One-time secrets
secrets.intro: Secrets created in this entity, most recent first. You never see their content, only their state. You can delete a pending or active secret before it is read.
secrets.introReadOnly: Secrets created in this entity, most recent first, read only. The content is never visible.
